source_caption_text:
Priorities are already set

The outro of Future and Nicki Minaj’s “You Da Baddest” video brings the whole visual to a close with the same laid-back luxury seen throughout. Set around a beachfront hotel in Miami, the final moments capture the two artists enjoying the lifestyle while Nicki’s presence keeps turning heads. Future’s repeated vocals carry the track through its closing seconds, leaving the video with a smooth finish.

That same energy is about to carry over to Vice City, where me and Lucia are going to be busy exploring Leonida while my IRL girl gets absolutely no attention. Whether we’re cruising along the coast, getting into trouble or just enjoying the city, she’ll have to wait while Lucia gets all the time and attention.

My IRL girl might be wondering why I’m taking so long to reply, but once I’m in Vice City, it’s a different story. Future and Nicki already gave us the soundtrack, and now it’s time to see how long me and Lucia can stay out there. 

#future #nickiminaj #hiphop
